body:
## Why
The pause the laptop already takes, made a verb (`docs/local-first.md` §3 rows `pause`/`resume`, §4 runtime table, §11 measurements).

## What
1. `src/runtime/claude-bg.js`: `pause` = `claude stop <job>`; `resume` = `claude --bg --resume <session_id> "continue"` with **no other flags**, cwd = the attempt's worktree (the saved options bring the hooks and the grant back; flags fork a copy; no prompt idles). Same job id, fresh pid; assert the transcript grew in the test (the fake runtime records it).
2. `src/runtime/process.js`: `pause` = `process.kill(-pid, 'SIGSTOP')`, refused on `win32`; `resume` = `SIGCONT`; `stop` = `SIGCONT`, then SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 5 s.
3. `src/lifecycle.js`: `pauseAttempt`/`resumeAttempt`: runtime first; `state.paused_attempts["n/k"] = iso` (`src/board.js` state helpers); then the row (`paused_at`, `paused_by: <host>`), through the outbox when offline. Resume: runtime, clear the marker, `resumed_at`, append `{ at, until, by }` to `pauses[]` after a fresh `loadRun`.
4. `src/dispatch.js`: a tick that finds a marker in `state.json` with no `paused_at` on the row repairs the row; `watchChild` deletes `ctx._cache['comments:<n>']` before its `loadRun`; every row-closing verb (`block`, `archive`, `requestChanges`, the web board's moves) calls `runtime.stop` when the row says paused.
5. `src/hook.js`: the Stop hook stands aside when `paused_attempts` lists the attempt. Measure and record in the PR whether the Stop hook fires on `claude stop` at all.
6. `src/cli.js`: `hkb pause <n>`, `hkb resume <n>`, refused under `KB_TASK`; `CLAUDE_DENY` gains `Bash(hkb pause*)`, `Bash(hkb resume*)`.
7. `src/serve.js` + `web/index.html`: `POST /api/tasks/:n/{start,pause,resume,stop}` through `runVerb`; pause/resume/stop/start buttons in the drawer; the card shows ⏸ when paused or suspended. `src/watch.js`: `paused`/`resumed` kinds.
8. `hkb show` renders `paused_at` and the `pauses[]` total.

## Done when
- [ ] Tests with the fake runtime: the order "runtime paused, marker written, then row"; a paused attempt is never reclaimed at any clock value (reuse B2's injected clock); resume appends exactly one window; a paused `process` attempt that is then `block`ed gets `SIGCONT` before SIGTERM; `watchChild` after an operator stop leaves the `stopped` row intact.
- [ ] A live check on this machine with a throwaway `claude --bg` session outside the repo (name it so `kb #` does not match), recorded in the PR: pause, resume with the prompt, the transcript grew, same job id.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` green; wiki `features/web-board.md` refreshed (the buttons).

## Contract
Row fields `paused_at`, `paused_by`, `resumed_at`, `pauses[]` (B2's shape); `state.json` key `paused_attempts`. The board-level verbs are B5's; the events stream is B6's.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: hkb pause <n> pauses the runtime first, records paused_attempts in state.json, then paused_at on the row; hkb resume <n> reverses it and appends the window to pauses[]; claude-bg pauses by claude stop and resumes flag-less with a prompt under the same job id; process freezes with SIGSTOP on the group and every stop sends SIGCONT first; the Stop hook stands aside on the marker; the web board has the buttons
title: hkb pause <n> and hkb resume <n>: the checkpoint for claude-bg, the freeze for process, the hooks marker, SIGCONT before every stop
